stories.title: COP31 fails to reach major climate deal as talks expose deep divisions
stories.brief: The talks fail to make a breakthrough on tackling climate change after a row about mentioning fossil fuels.

stories.title: Mysterious Mercury gets a visitor - after spacecraft's eight-year epic voyage
stories.brief: The mission is set to give us our best ever view of Mercury - the closest planet to the Sun.

stories.title: Veteran journalist Husain Naqi passes away in Lahore
stories.brief: The premier remembered Naqi as a “principled journalist who fearlessly raised voice for freedom of expression, democratic values and human rights throughout his life”. The president paid tribute to Naqi’s “services to journalism, freedom of expression and human rights”, the statement said.

stories.title: Naqvi warns fellow minister against repeated criticism
stories.brief: Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi on Sunday warned a fellow member of the cabinet against repeatedly criticising him, saying the minister would not be able to show his face if he responded to the remarks, Express News reported.

stories.title: Bilawal warns US-Iran dialogue collapse could widen conflict, says Pakistan optimistic about settlement
stories.brief: Pakistan People's Party (PPP) Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari warned that the Iran-US conflict could spread beyond its current boundaries if the ongoing diplomatic process collapses, while expressing optimism that both sides would reach a settlement soon.

stories.title: HEC to introduce MOFA attestation option on degree attestation portal
stories.brief: In a major relief for thousands of students struggling with lengthy and cumbersome attestation procedures, the Higher Education Commission (HEC) decided to integrate the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) attestation option into its online degree attestation portal.

stories.title: PML-N, PPP tug-of-war intensifies as Sherry warns Asif over fresh jibe at Bilawal
stories.brief: On November 19, Asif shared two video clips of Bilawal, one from an earlier parliamentary speech and another from his recent address at the Karachi Press Club (KPC).

stories.title: Veteran journalist, human rights activist Hussain Naqi passes away
stories.brief: Veteran journalist and human rights activist Hussain Naqi died in Lahore on Sunday, prompting tributes from President Asif Ali Zardari and Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif. The HRCP said it deeply mourned the death of Naqi, whom it described as a veteran journalist, trade unionist and human rights defender.
